description: Stage 4 / CODEX P0.1: Truant's beforeTurn 'skip' is a generic (non-threaded) hook -- mergeBattleConfigs discards its return value whenever a traits_config also exists (bundle.deobfuscated.js:81011-81015), so a merged Truant NEVER loafs, even though it does in an ability-only (no passives) battle. The 'water_retaliate' passive here is inert for this matchup (Slakoth is Normal-type, not Water) -- its only role is forcing buildTraitsConfig to return non-null so mergeBattleConfigs actually runs.
